traits.name: Nimble Escape
traits.text: Can Disengage or Hide as a bonus action on each of its turns.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.text: Advantage on attack rolls against a creature if an ally of the wolf is within 5 feet of it.

traits.name: Vulnerable
traits.text: Vulnerable to bludgeoning damage. Immune to poison.

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.text: If damage reduces it to 0 hit points, it makes a Constitution save (DC 5 + damage taken) unless the damage is radiant or a critical hit. On a success it drops to 1 hit point instead.

traits.name: Aggressive
traits.text: As a bonus action, can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature it can see.

traits.name: Poison
traits.text: A bitten target makes a DC 11 Constitution save, taking 2d8 poison damage on a failure or half on a success.

traits.name: Web (Recharge 5-6)
traits.text: Ranged attack +5, range 30/60 ft. On a hit the target is restrained by webbing (DC 12 Strength check to break free).

traits.name: Keen Sight
traits.text: Advantage on Perception checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Multiattack
traits.text: Makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its claws.

spells.name: Fire Bolt
spells.text: Ranged spell attack. On a hit the target takes 1d10 fire damage. A flammable object hit by this spell ignites if it isn't being worn or carried.
spells.higher: Damage increases to 2d10 at 5th level, 3d10 at 11th, and 4d10 at 17th.

spells.name: Mage Hand
spells.text: A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose. You can use your action to control it: manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, or stow or retrieve an item. It can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.

spells.name: Sacred Flame
spells.text: Flame-like radiance descends on a creature you can see. It must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 radiant damage. The target gains no benefit from cover for this save.
spells.higher: Damage increases to 2d8 at 5th level, 3d8 at 11th, and 4d8 at 17th.

spells.name: Vicious Mockery
spells.text: You unleash a string of insults laced with subtle enchantments at a creature that can hear you. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take 1d4 psychic damage and have disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

spells.name: Cure Wounds
spells.text: A creature you touch regains hit points equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. No effect on undead or constructs.
spells.higher: Healing increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 1st.

spells.name: Healing Word
spells.text: A creature of your choice that you can see regains hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier.
spells.higher: Healing increases by 1d4 for each slot level above 1st.

spells.name: Bless
spells.components: V, S, M (a sprinkling of holy water)
spells.text: You bless up to three creatures of your choice. Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, it can roll a d4 and add the number to the roll.
spells.higher: One additional creature for each slot level above 1st.

spells.name: Magic Missile
spells.text: You create three glowing darts of magical force. Each dart hits a creature of your choice that you can see and deals 1d4 + 1 force damage. The darts strike simultaneously and can be split between targets.
spells.higher: One more dart for each slot level above 1st.

spells.name: Shield
spells.text: An invisible barrier of magical force protects you. Until the start of your next turn you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from magic missile.

spells.name: Sleep
spells.components: V, S, M (a pinch of fine sand, rose petals, or a cricket)
spells.text: Roll 5d8; that many hit points of creatures within 20 feet of a point you choose fall unconscious, starting with the creature with the lowest current hit points. Undead and creatures immune to being charmed aren't affected.
spells.higher: Roll an additional 2d8 for each slot level above 1st.

spells.name: Thunderwave
spells.text: Each creature in a 15-foot cube originating from you makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failure it takes 2d8 thunder damage and is pushed 10 feet away; on a success it takes half damage and isn't pushed.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 1st.

spells.name: Hunter's Mark
spells.text: You mark a creature you can see as your quarry. You deal an extra 1d6 damage to it whenever you hit it with a weapon attack, and you have advantage on Perception or Survival checks made to find it.

spells.name: Misty Step
spells.text: Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see.

spells.name: Fireball
spells.components: V, S, M (a tiny ball of bat guano and sulfur)
spells.text: Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d6 fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success. The fire spreads around corners and ignites unattended flammable objects.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.
